title: Chapter 770 A Ghost
content:
Chapter 770 A Ghost

"Your Majesty, if what you say makes sense, it may be of benefit to you; if what you say is wrong, you can have me thrown into prison and held hostage in the city of Jiangling!"

Sui He confessed himself, Lu Jia also interceded for him, and Hei Fu asked his assistant to let Sui He continue to speak.

Suihe returned to the courtyard and said in a hurried tone: "Although the prince defeated Feng Wuze and captured Jiangling, Nanjun and other counties in the south of the Yangtze River, he relied on the secrets of each other to catch him by surprise."

【】

Although Suihe was scolded as a "corrupt Confucian" by his fellow villagers, in addition to studying poetry and calligraphy, he also adopted Huang Lao's skills. He even read the "Short and Long" book that his friend gave him when he was evading arrest from the court, and he gained quite a lot of experience. , and when he started talking, his eloquence was not inferior to that of Lu Jia!

"Today, the princes have taken over Jingzhou, but their household registration is less than one-tenth of the world's population, and the number of soldiers they support is not as good as that of the imperial court. If the imperial court reacts and decides to attack Zhao and destroy Chu, it will recruit hundreds of thousands of troops to attack. , I dare to ask you how to control it? How can you feel uneasy for your king..."

Seeing that he was eloquent, Hei Fu didn't let him go away. He slowly took a bowl of boiling water and blew it while saying: "Even if I am weak and the enemy is strong, what does this have to do with being called the King of Chu" ?”

"Of course it does matter!"

Sui He said: "Instead of waiting for the imperial court to attack, it is better to order the world to rebel against Qin, especially the three Chu areas. Qin destroyed the six kingdoms, and Chu was the most innocent. Therefore, Chu Nan Gong said, 'Although Chu has three households, if Qin is destroyed, Chu will definitely die.'" . The Southern Expeditionary Army under the command of the monarch originally had many people from the Three Chus, and had no good impressions of Qin, but they hoped to return to their hometown in the Huaihe River. If they could restore the Chu State, win over the people of the Three Chus, and fight against the powerful Qin together, they would win. The negative is unknown."

Heifu still disagreed: "Xiang Qiang was established as the king of Chu but was defeated in three days. This shows that the so-called banner of Chu is not easy to use."

Sui He laughed and said: "The prince is wrong. If a husband has a good horse and a solid chariot, Zang will be able to control him. Then people will laugh at him. If the king can control him well, he can travel thousands of miles in a day."

"The chariot and the horse are not different. They may travel thousands of miles, or they may be laughed at, but their skill and clumsiness are far different."

"Xiang Qiang couldn't get this chariot and horse, and he pretended to be the king of Chu. He was like Zang Huo running on foot. Naturally, he died and was killed, which made the world laugh. But the kings are different. The kings are the first to be righteous, and the world is famous. Today We already have an army of 100,000 men and occupy several counties, especially the capital of Jiangling and Ying, so we should be crowned king!"

Hei Fu still shook his head: "More than ten years ago, I captured Xiang Yan's flag, followed Wucheng Hou to destroy Shouchun's capital, and captured the King of Chu as a prisoner. Now I have reestablished Chu Sheji. Repeatedly, wouldn't it be a slippery slope in the world? Daji?"

Suihe thought otherwise: "Things are adapted to the circumstances of the world. If you don't distinguish the situation, what's the difference between you and the fool of the Chu State who is searching for a sword?"

"If you are worried, I have a plan to solve this embarrassment. I once heard that King Huai of Chu entered Qin and died. The people of Chu still mourn him. Why don't you claim to be the queen of Chu Huai?" When the country moved eastward, the descendants who stayed in Anlu remained anonymous and even joined the Qin army, just waiting for the opportunity to restore the state of Chu... In this way, filial piety is greater than loyalty, and national hatred is greater than personal kindness, which is justifiable."

"Self-proclaimed King Huai of Chu? She lurked in the Qin Chaotang and became the Marquis of Che?"

Hei Fu really didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He had so many ideas, and the enemy camp had come up with them in thirty years.

Suihe became more and more excited as he spoke: "After the king ascended the throne, he set out the banner of revenge for King Huai of Chu. Then he used the position of King of Chu as a chariot, the troops as horses, the orders as bridles, and the punishments as spurs. Defend the Three Chus and defeat the powerful Qin!"

He bowed and said: "I would like to serve as your envoy to Jiujiang, Donghai, Kuaiji, Huaiyang, and Sishui, and call on the surviving people of Chu to respond. Then the Western Chu and the Eastern Chu, and all the prefectures and counties who are suffering from the officials of Qin, will Punish the chief officials and kill them in response to the king! Attack the unjust and punish the Qin Dynasty! March into the Central Plains!"

"In this way, even the remnants of the five kingdoms of Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, and Qi will gather together to respond. Each will restore its kingdom, with the princes as the leaders, just like the story of the six kingdoms uniting to conquer Qin in the past, with poor food and scenery, and enter the pass together. If Qin is destroyed, why worry about the world not being able to do so?"

Hei Fu held the water and looked at Lu Jia aside: "No wonder you introduced him. His eloquence is so impressive that even I almost believed him."

Sui He became anxious and further said: "If you don't do this, someone will do it!"

"At this moment, in the land of Lianghuai and Dongchu, I am afraid that people have heard about what happened in Nanjun. Impatient people have begun to gather people to commit rebellion and kill officials to rebel. If they let them raise their banner first, it will be too late!"

"And if the prince fights first, others will take this as an order and accept the prince's appointment because of the prince's reputation. Although it is only in name, it can at least help the prince stir up the world's situation and share the burden. Some pressure from the Qin court to attack."

After saying this, Sui He fell to the ground and said, "That's all Sui He said, please check it out!"

"What you said is not unreasonable, and it is indeed helpful to me."

Hei Fu drank all the water in the bowl and said with a smile: "Nanjun is the land of Western Chu. I am raising an army to the Western Chu. If I really call myself the King of Chu, my name will be called the 'Overlord of the Western Chu'. How about that?"

Lu Jia and Sui He said in unison: "The overlord is the leader of the princes, just like the fifth uncle in ancient times. Now he can be the overlord, the emperor and the saint. It is extremely appropriate!"

"Hahaha."

Heifu smiled, but then he raised his hand high and slammed the pottery bowl in his hand to the ground, causing it to shatter all over the ground!

Following this crisp sound, a group of personal guards around the courtyard swarmed in and pushed Sui He to the ground!

"Suihe, your proposal is good, but it's a pity that I know who I am."

Heifu's smile has faded and he said solemnly:

"I am Heifu, a Guizhou leader on the side of Yunmengze. I am not the grandson of King Huai at all. In the Chu State, I would be the son of a rope pivot who would never get ahead. But in Qin's system, little by little I won a title for my meritorious service and was appreciated by His Majesty the First Emperor, so I was promoted to the position of Marquis Che. He thought I was dead and named me 'Wuzhong'."

This is Heifu Jubing's greatest prestige, a gold-lettered sign. If it's not bright enough even if it is polished every day, why should he pick it off himself?

"I want to be worthy of this title, so I will rebel against the treacherous ministers and traitors, not betray the Qin Dynasty, let alone establish myself as king and divide the country!"

Sui He struggled and said: "Although the princes raised troops to appease the Qin Dynasty, claimed to be loyal ministers, and even used the edicts on clothes and belts as orders, there were not many people who truly believed in them. In the eyes of the people in the world, the princes raised troops to fight against Qin, which was the same as self-reliance. The king is only separated by a thin layer of veil. If you stick to your identity and tie yourself up, you will lose the opportunity and regret it later."

Heifu was unmoved: "Even if it's just a layer of gauze, it can't be pierced. Otherwise, both me and this act of justice will become a big joke!"

He waved his hand: "Drag this man down and lock him up!"

…

After Suihe was dragged away, Heifu glanced at everyone, especially Lu Jia: "Do you agree with Suihe's plan?"

Lu Jia hurriedly said: "I don't comment at all, but I just feel that Suihe's proposal may allow the entire Sanchu land to join the monarch's banner..."

Heifu pointed at him and said: "Lu Jia, Lu Jia, are you really stupid and want to declare yourself the king of Chu? You can't imagine it. Before the three Chus respond, the Southern Expedition Army will have to fight on its own!"

He knew that with the spread of the death of the First Emperor and the great turmoil in the world, a ghost, a ghost of Zionism, was already wandering across the land of Kyushu...

Xiangqiang is just the first Caotou King. Next, in the hometown of the Six Kingdoms, the king's flag will probably be planted on every city wall.

"But there are some things that others can do, but I can't do. From Wu Zhonghou, who was in trouble in Fengtian, to self-proclaimed king, these are completely two routes, one south and one north."

Two roads diverged in a yellow wood, but unfortunately you can't both, you have to choose.

Heifu said: "If we change our ways easily, the morale of the three armies will definitely be high, and the Qin officials in the counties and counties they control will also be full of suspicion. This will bring trouble to ourselves. They will even give treacherous ministers and traitors the excuse to point at me." Shouting, 'Hei Fu is indeed a traitor and has a treacherous heart'!"

At that time, Sanchu's help has not been obtained, but it is passive everywhere. I am afraid that it will really be defeated and it will be a pioneer for others.

The character cannot be broken, and there are certain paths that cannot be taken wrong. Hei Fu does not want to be Wu Sangui.

And, most importantly...

"Write down my words! They will be recorded in the annals of history from now on!"

Lu Jia knew that something was wrong, so he hurriedly picked up his pen, but heard Hei Fu say:

"The most important thing is that I am not a descendant of King Huai of Chu. Even if I die and my bones turn to ashes, I will never allow my descendants to find some ancient sages, sages, princes, and six emperors for me. The king will be the ancestor!"

"Heifu is always the son of a Guizhou leader. He rises to the court step by step and holds the position of Chehou. In the future, he will even be able to hold the power of the world. He relies on a good system that allows common people to come forward. He relies on his own ability, not blood. This cannot be changed!"

Speaking of this, Heifu paused and continued:

"Master Xi once told me that officials are where the people's lives hang in the balance."

"Heifu is an official of Qin. He was an official in the past, he is now, and he will be in the future!"

Lu Jia's writing stopped, and his hands were shaking a little.

But Heifu ignored him and said directly: "I raised the army to bring the soldiers of the Southern Expedition home. It was to turn things around and relieve the people. It was not to add a useless crown to my head. Wearing a slippery black cloth, you think you have received your destiny!"

"Destiny lies with the people, not with the six kings' kingdoms that have long since decayed! I once personally risked the stone under the banner of the First Emperor and pushed them down with all my strength, but I will never raise them up again!"

"I am a successor to the First Emperor's ideals! This will never change!"

…
